QuestInfo.name: Hair Stylist, Booked!
QuestInfo.0: Thanks to your hard work, Marshall agreed to take the gig. Give #bLana#k the good news.
QuestInfo.1: Lana suggested that you ask #bLala#k, Blake's number one fan, for help with the costumes.
QuestInfo.2: #bLala#k was thrilled to hear that Blake was finally make a debut, and asked you to give her some time to brainstorm.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 1,900\nCan proceed to the Costume Preparation quest\n

0.0: Well? Did you get Marshall to do Blake's hair?\r\n#L0##bI sure did! I convinced Marshall to help us.#l\n#k
0.1: Phew, what a relief! Now, let's see what's next. Let me just check my chart here... Ah! We need to get Blake a costume. A costume is what makes a performance pop! #h0#, are you ready for your next job?

yes.0: I think we need Lala, Blake's number one fan, to help us on this one. She may be young, but she's got an incredible sense of fashion. Hurry over to #bLala#k.

no.0: You must hurry. We don't have much time.

1.0: What brings you here? Hm? Really?! Blake is finally making his debut?! Of course I'll take care of his costume, are you kidding?!

yes.0: Hm, hm, hmmm. I think I need some time to brainstorm. Please come back to see me in a little bit. Tee hee.

npc.0: Please go see #bLala#k. She should be wearing an adorable school uniform.
